title: The Note on the Screen
logline: A man's blank screen finally lights up after a note, a shop and a key.

world.place: A big open-plan office and the corner shop down the street, present day.
world.time_span: Weekday morning for the office and the shop, then the same office that night.
rules: plain office furniture and shop goods, no brand names
the note is yellow and handwritten; the key is brass with a paper tag
the whole office floor is in frame in every wide view
world.palette_note: Sam blue, the note and shop lamps yellow, grey office, brown shop wood

sets.description: A big open-plan office on a weekday: four rows of workstations on grey carpet under a tiled ceiling, a city outside the windows, a glass meeting room in the north-east corner.
sets.layout: Camera side is south (-Y). Sam's desk is in the first row at the left (worker_a); the middle aisle runs away from the camera to the glass meeting room at the far right. The kitchenette is on the east wall. From the south-west corner the wide sees the whole floor with the city in the north windows; the reverse angle looks back at the entrance door and the street windows.

shots.vo_text: Every morning Sam stares at the same blank screen in a busy open office. Today a tiny note is stuck to it. It says: go to the shop on the corner.
shots.purpose: Hook: an ordinary man at an ordinary desk gets a strange note, in a place big enough to feel lonely in.
shots.action: Sam sits at his desk in the first row and stares at his blank screen. The office hums around him. A small yellow note on the screen says to go to the shop on the corner.

views.shows: Sam, in profile, at his desk, staring at a blank screen while the office blurs behind him
views.why: the first second shows who this is and what he is stuck with

views.shows: the whole open-plan floor from the south-west corner: rows of desks, the city in the windows, Sam small at the left
views.why: the place, and how many other people are not looking at his screen

views.shows: the yellow note stuck to the corner of the screen, a shaky close look
views.why: the clue the story turns on must be the subject of a frame

views.shows: Sam reads the note, his eyebrows rising
views.why: his reaction is the question the next shot answers
views.still_reason: held on Sam's face while the message lands; any move would soften the beat

shots.sound: office hum, keyboard clicks, a paper note rustling

light.motivation: warm shop lamps against the cool street light in the window

shots.vo_text: The shopkeeper is already smiling. She slides a small box across the counter. Inside, a key marked with Sam's desk number.
shots.purpose: The turn: the shop knows who he is. The shopkeeper is expecting him and hands over a key marked with his desk number.
shots.action: The shopkeeper smiles behind her counter. Sam arrives at the counter. She slides a small cardboard box across it; Sam opens it and finds a brass key tagged with his desk number.

views.shows: the whole shop from the door: shelves, beams, the counter at the right with the shopkeeper behind it
views.why: a new place after the whip: the viewer must know where he is before she moves

views.shows: the shopkeeper and Sam either side of the counter, the box sliding between them
from above, the open box on the counter with a brass key tagged with a desk number
views.why: the object the ending needs, readable

shots.sound: door bell, a box sliding on wood, a key clinking

light.motivation: a dark floor with one warm desk lamp, the screen waking at the end

shots.vo_text: That night the office is empty. Sam turns the key in the bottom drawer, and the screen finally lights up.
shots.purpose: Payoff: the same office, now empty at night; the key opens the drawer and the screen answers.
shots.action: The office is dark and empty except for the glow of the street. Sam crouches at his desk, turns the key in the bottom drawer, and his blank screen lights up.

views.shows: the same floor at night: dark rows of desks, city lights in the windows, Sam alone at the left
views.why: the same place as the hook, changed: that is the passage of the day

views.shows: from low behind the desk, Sam's hand turning the key in the bottom drawer
views.why: the action the key was for

views.shows: Sam's face lit by the screen as it comes on
views.why: the answer the hook asked for

shots.sound: a lock clicking, a screen powering up with a soft chime
